In terms of personal opinion, I believe it's completely right for anyone, regardless of gender, to ask for directions. So, putting it all together, I don't see any reason why it would be wrong for a woman to ask for directions to a pizza place. It's a normal, everyday action that doesn't infringe on anyone's rights or violate any social norms, provided it's done politely and in a safe environment.
